result_preview.title: Opportunity Qualification Advisor
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously evaluates sales opportunities against qualification criteria and recommends actions.
result_preview.description: This AI agent analyzes incoming SalesOpportunity records by examining customer account characteristics, deal value, customer history, and engagement patterns. It automatically qualifies or disqualifies opportunities based on configurable enterprise rules, prioritizes high-value prospects, and recommends next-best-actions to sales representatives. The agent reduces manual qualification overhead and ensures consistent lead scoring across the sales organization.

result_preview.description: Monitors customer account interactions and engagement patterns to continuously score and rank sales opportunities. Coordinates real-time opportunity classification based on propensity signals, account fit, and engagement velocity. Processes incoming customer signals to automatically prioritize high-value opportunities and trigger targeted sales actions.

result_preview.title: Sales Product Change Coordinator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates product change impact assessment and sales opportunity alignment.
result_preview.description: Monitors engineering changes and material updates to coordinate sales strategy adjustments. Processes product item modifications and automates notification workflows to affected customer accounts and sales opportunities. Coordinates cross-functional communication between product management and sales teams to ensure opportunity relevance during product transitions.
